title: A reduction theorem for the Feit conjecture
inspection_outcome: Full source text and specified source/reference images inspected; exact computations retained; all pages of final compiled report actually inspected. Initial scientific assessment Major; independent adjudication pending.
summary: Theorem 7.15(iv) omits rational nonextendible nonbasic spin characters, leaving a missing proof case in the alternating-group application. A separate displayed value/class-count defect is local; the field formula can survive its repair.

focused_checks.reason: Primary read the exact partition/parity definitions, Theorem 7.15's two exhaustive alternatives, Corollaries 7.7/7.11/7.13, and its explicit use in Theorem 7.17. The nonbasic strict partition (9,1) at n=10 has even n-length=8 and signed discriminant 9. The two constituents are rational yet distinct and swapped by odd conjugation; hence neither extends. Both alternatives fail already for chi, regardless of eta or m. Primary read the retained rational Q-function calculation and independently checked the exceptional coefficient: q9*q1-2*q10 has p9*p1 coefficient -4/9, giving symmetric value -1 and alternating values ( -1 +/-3)/2 =1,-2; degrees split 128 into 64. A current Poppler extraction of Livesey pp.7-10 confirms the self-associate classification and difference formula independently of the erroneous piecewise statement. Its generator presentation differs, but t_j -> z^j t_j converts the adjacent-product relation while preserving the quotient and central involution; character fields are unaffected by central signs. The third rational/nonextendible case has multiplicity one from Corollary 7.13(ii), equal fields, matching odd-conjugation stabilizers and full Galois stabilizers, so Lemma 3.3(i)/Theorem 3.2(a) repair this route for n>=8. Exceptional covers remain outside that repair. No counterexample to Theorem C itself or to Feit is asserted.

Primary read the exact chosen presentation, lifted-class definition and overlapping branches on p.33. At lambda=mu=(5), the odd branch is 1/2 and the exceptional branch +/-sqrt5/2. Primary checked the reviewer-authored Clifford construction, projector and commutant scripts and their retained exact outputs. The negative-square Clifford generators give the source presentation, the four-dimensional representation splits into distinct rank-two irreducibles, and traces are (1+/-sqrt5)/2. The algebraic-integer obstruction independently excludes 1/2. The preimage of 24 five-cycles has 48 elements; its cyclic-centralizer preimage has order 10, hence four classes of size 12, not two. The sum/difference correction agrees with the independent Livesey difference formula. Its added rational average preserves the character-field information; additional core reduction failure is not established. All computation runs remain attributed to the initial review; no new execution is claimed.

problems.title: Theorem 7.15 omits rational nonextendible nonbasic spin characters

anchors: Last paragraph of the even-partition proof

problems.original_claim_paraphrase: Every nonbasic spin irreducible chi of Atilde_n admits a multiplicity-one same-field parabolic constituent eta and satisfies either rationality with extension of both characters, or field degree two with nonextension and Galois/outer fusion.
hypothesis_checks: (9,1) has distinct positive parts summing to ten.
n-lambda_length=8 is even, so both alternating-cover spin constituents exist.
lambda!=(10), hence the characters are nonbasic.
2A10 is in the universal double-cover range; n!=6.
No nonsquare-discriminant assumption is in Theorem 7.15.
problems.decisive_evidence: Both character fields equal Q(sqrt(9))=Q; all exact values are rational. The two distinct constituents are interchanged by odd conjugation, hence neither extends to the symmetric cover. Therefore (a) and (b) both fail, irrespective of eta or m.
problems.independent_computation: Exact Schur Q_(9,1)=q9*q1-2*q10 expansion; degrees 64; exceptional values 1 and -2; squared norms 1 and mutual inner product 0.
alternative_readings: A quadratic-field expression may degenerate to Q, but the explicit degree-two alternative cannot.
The example is not basic and is not excluded by n=6.
Correcting Theorem 7.5 does not remove the rational nonextension case.
Theorem 7.16(b) separately handles analogous square-discriminant basic spin characters; it does not fill the nonbasic statement.
problems.impact: A false structural theorem used explicitly to prove Theorem C leaves its printed nonbasic spin argument incomplete. No counterexample to Theorem C itself, Theorem A, or the Feit conjecture is established.

correction.statement: For n>=8 add a third alternative: chi and eta are rational and both nonextendible. Preserve multiplicity one and same field; compare the shared odd-conjugation action and full Galois stabilizers.
correction.verification: With the same parabolic subgroup and Corollary 7.13(ii), rationality plus matching automorphism stabilizers gives Lemma 3.3(i), and Theorem 3.2(a) supplies the inductive condition.
correction.limits: Changes the original exhaustive alternatives; does not validate the original two-case theorem. Exceptional universal covers remain separately handled. No author adoption verified.

problems.title: Theorem 7.5 omits the rational average term and Lemma 7.3 omits extra alternating classes
problems.original_claim_paraphrase: For lambda in D_even, the displayed spin value has an odd-cycle branch and an exceptional lambda branch; the corresponding lifted cycle set is asserted to have two alternating-cover classes.
hypothesis_checks: mu=(5) has odd parts and also equals lambda; both displayed branch conditions hold.
Basic spin characters are allowed by Theorem 7.5.
Explicit matrices satisfy every defining relation of the source's chosen double cover.
problems.decisive_evidence: Explicit 4x4 Clifford matrices split into two distinct irreducible 2x2 alternating-cover constituents, with canonical five-cycle traces (1-sqrt(5))/2 and (1+sqrt(5))/2. The preimage of all five-cycles has 48 elements and centralizer 10, giving four classes of size 12.
problems.independent_computation: All source group relations, projection identities, exact characteristic polynomial x^4-x^3+x^2-x+1 and constituent traces checked. Full/even commutant dimensions 1/2 and projection ranks 2/2 establish irreducibility of both summands.
alternative_readings: Giving either displayed branch precedence gives an incorrect value.
Central sign choices or exchanging constituent labels do not repair the absent average term.
problems.impact: A definite local character-value/class-count error in the exact typeset preprint. The corrected rational average term preserves the quadratic field information, so additional core damage has not been established from this error alone.

correction.statement: psi_pm(g)=(phi(g) +/- Delta_lambda(g))/2, with the exceptional difference supported on lambda; retain four alternating classes when the cycle type has distinct odd parts.
correction.verification: Exact n=5 matrix computation; sum/difference identity and relevant Livesey character-classification formula.
correction.limits: Does not by itself repair Problem 1; source image binding complete; author adoption unverified.
